text_block_list.text:
My first three years with Bamboo Memory.
Those fiery days of chasing "dreams" and talking
about "dreams" have reached their end.

"Yet, her 'dream' knows no end,
and the destination of that road is still far away."

That powerful run that illuminated every "dream"
will surely be passed down for generations to come.
As long as everyone holds a "dream" in their hearts—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Already passing the 600-meter marker and rounding the fourth corner!!
Here they come into the home stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Haaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo & Yaeno
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOOOOAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Under 100 meters to go!!
Neck and neck!!
————And they cross the line!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Aaaagh!!!
Today's race got me so totally hyped up toooo!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Truly, it was a thrilling and wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Yaeno! Your running had even
more power behind it today, didn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Looks like you really gained something
from facing off against your grandfather, su...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
That may well be the case.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since that day I scored my very first point against my grandfather,
a new—and powerful—sensation
has continuously resided within my mind and body."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...My grandfather's smile back then, and the
warmth in his words when he praised my technique—
I could never forget that..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
My next "dream" is to rely on this sensation
to reach even higher, uncharted territory...
in both my duty to protect and my running.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you let your guard down,
I will leave you behind and forge ahead,
Bamboo-san.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
Yaeno's gonna get stronger and stronger, so
I gotta aim even higher, higher still!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: —The same goes for me, too!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Our goal is to go beyond full bloom into glorious grand bloom!
Until I show that the great cherry blossom stands at the heart of this era, I will keep reaching for greater heights!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh! Chiyono O!!
You've gotten even more fired up ever since your match with Maruzen-senpai, haven't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Because I'm...
also Maruzen-san's rival!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—I'll never forget how I felt after going all out against Maruzen-san
and having her tell me that we're rivals from now on.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In that moment, I made up my mind! I'm going to
bloom even brighter than I do now, and shine so I can
have an even more incredible race with Maruzen-san—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That's my new "dream"...!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
To surpass Maruzen-san and shine brighter—
I won't lose!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Chiyonoo...! I need to learn from that passionate spirit of yours too...!!
You're so cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly...
As someone who runs in the same era, it makes me strive to be like that as well.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ardan-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: "Strong, passionate, and dazzling. Following everyone's example, I intend to challenge the fateful star that awaits me with a brilliance truly my own."

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "...My race against big sis is coming up real soon, huh."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I was truly surprised that my sister found value
in running alongside me and challenged me to a race herself, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps that was the greatest proof of all that I, Mejiro Ardan, have left a definite mark of my existence upon this world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Then the "dream" I must strive for
is to face the brilliance of that supreme treasure, surpass it,
and reach even further... into unknown territory.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: —Just as everyone aims for it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...We can totally do it! 
After all, we're the best generation ever!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is burning with a new "dream"...!
I can't afford to lose...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(I'll find a new "dream" of my own,
and together with Trainer-san, I'm gonna
burn even brighter...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Come to think of it—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what happened
to Trainer's "dream" now...?

—One day, after Bamboo Memory's
fierce battles had quieted down just a little.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, here comes today's star!
Let's welcome the Umamusume crowned
Best Sprinter, Bamboo Memory!!”
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
EVERYONE!!
Thank you so very much for gathering here today for my sake!!!
“—Today at the racecourse, an event was held to celebrate Bamboo Memory being awarded Best Sprinter/Miler Umamusume.”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory!
Congraaatsss!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Thanks as always for an incredible race!!
Make my blood boil even hotter!!

text_block_list.name: Lots of Fans
text_block_list.text:
(Bamboo! Bamboo! Bamboo!
Bamboo! Bamboo! Bamboo!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaaa...!!!
Ev-Everyone's cheers are way too intense...!!
It's making me ache all overrrr!!!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Well then, let's hear how Bamboo Memory
and her Trainer are feeling right now!
First off—

And so, alongside Bamboo Memory,
who was hyped up by the cheering crowd,
we gave our comments before the fans—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
“—And now, at long last!
We will now begin the commemorative run
by Bamboo Memory!”

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run, I wanna ruuun~~!
I can't help wanting to get out there and run ASAP~~!!
choice_data_list: It's just one lap, so let's go all out!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright then, I'm heading out!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Oooooooooooh!!!
(WOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)
Bamboo Memory thrilled the fans with her powerful running. Just when it seemed she would finish the planned course in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Not even clooooooose!!!

Bamboo Memory didn't stop even after crossing
the finish line and just kept running...!
choice_data_list: Just one lap is enough, right!?
Just one lap is enough, okay!?

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
W-What is happening here!?
Bamboo Memory has entered
her second lap!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Bamboo Memory!!
Keep dazzling us with runs like that from now on, too!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool, Bamboo!!
I'll always be cheering you onーー!!

It was a sudden, runaway moment, but fortunately,
the fans loved it all the more,
and the anniversary event wrapped up in high spirits—
And on the way home from the commemorative event—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —I'm so sorry about the commemorative run!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... everyone's cheers were
just so overwhelmingly passionate...
that I ended up...—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, that's fine, but—
choice_data_list: Everyone saw a "dream" in your running, Bamboo.

text_block_list.text: Watching the stands made it clear. Every single fan was pinning their "dreams" on Bamboo Memory.
It was bound to be a thrilling, legendary showdown... or perhaps a history-making challenge... but either way, it would be filled with brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Up until today, I've run for my own 'dream'
and cheered on everyone else's 'dreams,' but—"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
If everyone was somehow seeing a "dream"
through me without me even knowing...
then that—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm super duper happy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: …………Um, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What's your "dream"
right now, Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Same as what I yelled into the sunset before... is it about me becoming a strong Umamusume?
choice_data_list: ...That wish came true a long time ago.

text_block_list.text:
Through relentless effort up to this day, Bamboo
Memory has brilliantly proven herself as the strongest
sprinter and miler of her generation.

Bamboo Memory has
made my "dream" come true.
—What kind of running will Bamboo Memory show us from here on out?
Just like the fans, everything I dream of right now is born from Bamboo Memory.

"In other words,
without Bamboo Memory, my 'dream'
can no longer exist."

I want to keep supporting her, treating her "dream"
as my own "dream." I put those feelings into words,
plain and true—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Then I'll just keep on
showing everyone the 'dream'!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
For the fans, and for you, Trainer!
I'm gonna show everyone
so many fiery, passionate "dreams"!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
That's me, Bamboo Memory!!
The strongest, greatest Uma Musume and—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's your "dream"!!!!
